name: Erasing the Invisible
description: Evaluate the robustness of invisible watermarking techniques in AI-generated images against adversarial attacks, focusing on watermark removal while preserving image quality.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants are provided with 300 watermarked images in PNG format per submission. These images are embedded with watermarks using techniques such as Gaussian Shading, StegaStamp, JigMark, PRC, StableSignature, and Trufo. Some images may have double watermarks (e.g., Gaussian Shading + JigMark).

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Participants must submit 300 attacked images in PNG format where the watermarks have been removed or disrupted. The output is evaluated based on watermark detection performance and image quality degradation.

field.name: image_id
field.description: Unique identifier for each image, e.g., image_001.

field.name: attacked_image
field.description: PNG image with the watermark removed or disrupted.

cr:evaluation.notes: The final score is calculated as the Euclidean distance in a 2D space: sqrt(Q^2 + A^2), where A = 1 - TPR@0.1%FPR and Q is a weighted average of eight image quality metrics normalized to [0.1, 0.9]. Lower scores indicate better performance.
